subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter options for procurement
messages:
From: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@bigbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement-team@bigbank.com
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request for vendor onboarding

Hi Hannah,

We're working through vendor onboarding for a new internal offering and need to collect your SOC 2 Type II artifacts. Could you confirm whether Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report that covers an audit period overlapping calendar 2026? Specifically our internal auditors asked for: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter or management attestation if the audit period doesn't align with our procurement window
- Any redacted system description that is safe to share

A few quick procurement questions: do you have a standard secure delivery method (SFTP / secure SharePoint / reviewer portal), and do you require an NDA or PO before sharing?

We'd like to get materials by the end of January if possible. If there are options for a short-form bridge letter vs. a more detailed "after date" addendum, please indicate what you typically provide and the expected turnaround.

Thanks,
Emily Rogers
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Big Bank Corp
[Attachment: onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@bigbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request for vendor onboarding

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the clear list. Quick summary up front: we can provide a secure package and two bridge-letter options. Details below and next steps.

What we can share now:
- PDF of our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (we maintain a redacted system description for external sharing)
- Draft bridge letter (two flavors: short-form attestation of no material changes; extended letter with control-change summary)
- A short redaction guidance note (what we remove vs what we keep)

Typical timelines and delivery options:
- If you accept a redacted report + bridge letter: we can post a secure link within 3 business days after legal review (usually 48–72 hours).
- If you need an unredacted system description under an executed NDA: 5–7 business days after the NDA is in place.

Delivery methods we support:
- Secure Share (pre-authenticated link with reviewer access; preferred)
- SFTP transfer for enterprise reviewers
- Temporary entry in our compliance reviewer portal (ID-based access)

What we need from you to proceed quickly:
1) Confirmation which bridge-letter flavor you prefer (short vs. extended)
2) Whether the redacted system description is acceptable or if you require an NDA/PO first
3) Contact for your procurement/legal team to exchange an NDA (if required)

I've CC'd Marissa (Head of Security & Compliance) to handle the package upload and final review, and Vivek from Sales to help with contract/procurement questions if a PO is needed. We'll attach a draft bridge letter and redaction guidance in the next message.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0124
[Attachment: none]

From: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@bigbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement-team@bigbank.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request for vendor onboarding

Hi Hannah — thanks for the quick reply. Procurement confirms a redacted report + bridge letter will be acceptable for our FY27 intake. Please proceed with the short-form bridge letter (attestation of no material changes).

Delivery preferences: secure SharePoint link is preferred. Our team will not require an NDA for a redacted package.

A couple of clarifying items:
- Can you confirm the audit period covered by the report you intend to share? Our control window for this vendor review is 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31 — if your report ends earlier, we'll need a bridge letter that covers changes since the report's end date.
- It would be helpful if you could include a one-paragraph summary for our internal auditors that explains what the bridge letter covers (language they can paste into their vendor-risk notes).

If you can get the package up by Jan 18 that would keep us on schedule.

Thanks,
Emily

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@bigbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request for vendor onboarding

Hi Emily — great, short-form bridge letter it is. Quick answers:
- The report we will share is our SOC 2 Type II for the period 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30 (final issued 2025-11-15).
- Because that ends before your 2026 control window, the short-form bridge letter will attest that there have been no material changes to the control environment since 2025-09-30 through a specified "bridge" date; we can make the bridge date Jan 1, 2027 (covers your 2026 year).

I've pasted below a one-paragraph summary auditors can use (feel free to copy):

"Redwood Inference provided a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30. Per vendor attestation (bridge letter dated 2027-01-01), Redwood confirms there were no material changes to the control environment affecting applicable Trust Services Criteria from 2025-09-30 through 2027-01-01. The vendor supplied a redacted system description suitable for external review."

Next steps: Marissa will upload the redacted PDF and the bridge-letter draft to a secure SharePoint link and send you access. Expect that link by EOD Jan 11; if legal wants an executed NDA for additional artifacts we will flag that.

I'll also attach a short redaction guidance note for your auditors explaining what's been redacted.

Best,
Hannah
[Attachment: bridge_letter_template_short.docx]
